name: Downward-Facing Dog
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of your shoulders and fingers spread wide.
Tuck your toes and press through your palms to lift your hips high and back into an inverted V.
Lengthen your spine and ease your heels gently toward the floor while letting your head relax between your arms.
Hold the stretch while breathing steadily, then bend your knees and lower gently to the floor.
tips: Let your knees bend slightly if straightening them causes your lower back to round.
Press evenly through your palms and keep your shoulders drawing away from your ears.
